info.title: LiteLLM API
info.description:
Proxy Server to call 100+ LLMs in the OpenAI format. [**Customize Swagger Docs**](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/enterprise#swagger-docs---custom-routes--branding)

👉 [```LiteLLM Admin Panel on /ui```](/ui). Create, Edit Keys with SSO. Having issues? Try [```Fallback Login```](/fallback/login)

💸 [```LiteLLM Model Cost Map```](https://models.litellm.ai/).

🔎 [```LiteLLM Model Hub```](/ui/model_hub_table). See available models on the proxy. [**Docs**](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/ai_hub)

x-source.scope: POST 200 responses only; referenced component schemas copied unchanged

CustomToolCallOutputItem.title: CustomToolCallOutputItem
CustomToolCallOutputItem.description:
A custom/freeform tool call output item (e.g. apply_patch).

Mirrors the ``custom_tool_call`` variant of OpenAI's Responses API output.
Unlike ``OutputFunctionToolCall`` which uses ``arguments`` (JSON string),
this uses ``input`` (raw string) for the tool payload.

ResponseFormatJSONObject.title: ResponseFormatJSONObject
ResponseFormatJSONObject.description:
JSON object response format.

An older method of generating JSON responses.
Using `json_schema` is recommended for models that support it. Note that the
model will not generate JSON without a system or user message instructing it
to do so.
